_comment: Menu of what a platform policy file can tweak. A policy changes a behaviour every device already has by default; list a record only to change that default. Wiring, names, ports and UUIDs are not policy: they belong in the topology, board and entity files.

notPolicy.RecoveryPackages: Lives in the board file of the device it recovers (the BMC or HMC module for the ERoT and USB packages).
notPolicy.NvBoard: Lives in the platform topology file.
notPolicy.NvDevice: Lives in the board and entity files.
